package lexicalclosure {
  final lazy module val Mutable: lexicalclosure.Mutable =
    new lexicalclosure.Mutable()
  final module class Mutable() extends Object() {
    this: lexicalclosure.Mutable.type =>
    def mutableCapture: Int => Int =
      {
        var delta: Int = 2
        (x: Int) =>
          {
            x + delta
          }
      }
  }
}
